capabilities.description: 用调用方选定的特征/规则匹配固定历史情景；原始可知记录与显式历史回放分开，逐品种和条件组给计数、基线与反例，经验频率不是已校准概率。

frozen_at.description: Actual plan record timestamp supported by plan.ref, never invented or backfilled. Unknown prior selection must be exploratory.

tolerance.description: Required for numeric rules matching. Optional and unused for distance matching; never substitutes for max_distance.

at.description: Decision cutoff: outcomes must already be mature and available at this time, even if as_of is later.

replay.description: Explicit virtual prefix and matured-outcome clocks; outcome.available_at retains actual observation time.

origin.description: Omission keeps original observation chronology. Historical replay is explicit, exploratory and uses separate real and virtual clocks.

replay.description: Actual generation and latest observation of all fixed inputs; code/data refs are required direct dependencies at the fixed-ref entrypoint.

usage.purpose: 用调用方选定的特征/规则匹配固定历史情景，逐品种范围和条件组给出计数、基线、反例与经验频率。经验频率不是已校准概率。
usage.inputs: 参数见已声明README.md、METHOD.md及examples中的完整算例；inline入口直接接收对应JSON对象，refs入口接收operation和固定input_ref。所有方法、阈值和适用条件由用户/Agent明确选择。 回看早于今天固定计划的历史query时，显式origin:historical_replay并按REPLAY.md提供真实生成/观察与虚拟cutoff；不要回填frozen_at或挪动query.at。
usage.outputs: 完整JSON计算结果，含原计划、输入摘要、来源、样本筛选和缺失；match返回decision_at/cohorts/selection，经验频率不等于概率；calibrate返回groups/current_predictions/split/selection_status。今天选方法或原选择不明使用exploratory，只留回顾诊断，不给当前校准概率。没有通用研究合格判定或交易授权。
limitations: 只消费inline cases；source_refs与plan.ref只作来源标签，绝不读取。
按观察时点过滤特征available_at，并要求结果窗口已到期且可得。Prospective模式排除计划冻结前样本；exploratory不构成前瞻验证。
显式历史回放只限exploratory；核对双时钟和固定代码/输入引用，不认证当时数据版本，不产生实时预测概率。

capabilities.description: 用固定历史预测与实际标签做isotonic校准，过去拟合、后续独立时间评价，输出逐条件组Brier/可靠性/基线及无标签当前预测。

frozen_at.description: Actual plan record timestamp supported by plan.ref, never invented or backfilled. Unknown prior selection must be exploratory.

minimum_fit.description: Explicit fit sample target; advisory unless sample_policy is user+required. At least 2 actual nonoverlapping fit records with class and score variation are structurally necessary.

minimum_evaluation.description: Explicit scored evaluation sample target; advisory unless sample_policy is user+required. At least 1 actual fit-disjoint scored record is structurally necessary.

mode.description: prospective requires a genuinely prior recorded method plan. When selecting methods now on old logs, or original selection is unknown, use exploratory and the actual frozen_at; never backfill a fictional date.

sample_policy.description: Omit for agent advisory sample targets. Only an actual user instruction may set source:user plus mode:required; never downgrade that fixed requirement after seeing results. Advisory shortfalls produce limited point estimates with actual counts. Structural missing data still produces null.

prediction_available_at.description: Actual original prediction availability; for historical_replay actual generated/published time >=replay.generated_at, never a backfilled historical date.

model_trained_through.description: Original recorded model training cutoff; for explicit replay, virtual maximum training-data cutoff <=feature_cutoff and training_label_cutoff, not a claim the model physically ran then.

origin.description: Omit for original recorded prediction semantics. historical_replay is exploratory only and requires decision_at plus full replay provenance; never mix origins.

decision_at.description: Replay virtual historical decision time, exactly equal to at; never the actual generation/publication time.

generated_at.description: Actual execution time, at/after the real frozen plan and after the historical decision.

feature_cutoff.description: Latest virtual information time used for features, no later than decision_at.

training_label_cutoff.description: Latest virtual availability time of training labels, no later than decision_at.

outcome_available_at.description: Explicit virtual information-clock availability for the target outcome, at/after its horizon end. Actual retrieval/observation stays in outcome.available_at.

usage.purpose: 用固定历史预测与实际标签做isotonic校准，过去拟合、后续独立时间评价，输出逐条件组Brier/可靠性/基线及无标签当前预测。
usage.inputs: 参数见已声明README.md、METHOD.md及examples中的完整算例；inline入口直接接收对应JSON对象，refs入口接收operation和固定input_ref。所有方法、阈值和适用条件由用户/Agent明确选择。 可显式使用origin:historical_replay+decision_at+replay来源对象，保存今天真实生成时间、历史prefix cutoff和固定代码/数据refs；仅exploratory，不修改原记录时间规则。
usage.outputs: 完整JSON计算结果，含原计划、输入摘要、来源、样本筛选和缺失；match返回decision_at/cohorts/selection，经验频率不等于概率；calibrate返回groups/current_predictions/split/selection_status。今天选方法或原选择不明使用exploratory，只留回顾诊断，不给当前校准概率。没有通用研究合格判定或交易授权。 样本目标默认advisory，不足时当前估计标limited并给实际n/范围/理由；仅用户required阈值额外阻止输出，结构性无数据始终null。 回放仅称时间分割回放评价，保留真实生成/结果获取时刻与虚拟信息时钟；当前概率和可用校准grid始终null。
limitations: 只消费inline records；不得传Strategy隔离留出的未来行。
置信区间针对独立评估样本事件率，不是当前概率参数的置信区间。样本/支持不足返回null和原因，性能差仍保留条件结果。

capabilities.description: 读取并验证固定单行输入，执行相同匹配/校准后发布完整原样JSON结果，返回紧凑摘要和result_ref供后续图表、分析与引用；不属于input-only能力。

operation_id.description: 可选稳定发布操作ID；重试保持相同ID和固定输入。省略时按操作、精确输入引用和版本派生。

result_data.description: 完整单行json-rows结果的路径、字节数、内容摘要与complete标记。

summary.description: 最多8个条件组的展示摘要；完整样本、可靠性和逐行结果读取result_ref。

usage.purpose: 读取并验证固定单行输入，执行相同匹配/校准后发布完整原样JSON结果，返回紧凑摘要和result_ref供后续图表、分析与引用；不属于input-only能力。
usage.inputs: operation:match|calibrate、完整input_ref，可选operation_id；输入仍是固定单行JSON包。原方法、参数、时钟与证据不改，重复调用使用相同操作ID和输入。
usage.outputs: result_ref是已发布的完整单行json-rows DataRef，rows.json原样保留完整计算结果；result_data给出内容摘要/大小，summary只提供最多8组的精简预览。用data_read或resources.read按需读取完整结果，不把工具预览当全集。
limitations: 最多读取8 MiB固定输入，完整输出最多32 MiB，超过预算明确失败而不截断发布。
真实effects是resources.read/create/publish；没有网络、模型或状态集合，不属于隔离留出的input-only能力。
资源创建和发布复用宿主幂等operationId及事务/CAS机制；不修改旧成果，不从已知结果重选方法，不把经验频率当当前概率。
